title: fix(app-shell): a Monaco loader that cannot be reached is reported once and leaves nothing uncaught (objectui#11800)
body:
Fixes #11800

Clause-②: no

## What changes

On an install that cannot reach the Monaco CDN (no egress, or a Content-Security-Policy that blocks `cdn.jsdelivr.net`), Studio's source editors already fell back to a plain textarea, by design. They also left uncaught `Event` errors on the page and logged "Monaco initialization: error: Event". With this change the page logs one `console.warn` that names the loader URL it could not fetch, and nothing is left uncaught. The textarea fallback itself is unchanged. Monaco is still loaded from the CDN: the triage direction (comment 6043126346) keeps bundling out of this card.

- `useMonacoFallback` calls `loader.init()` once per page (`probeMonacoLoader`), and every mount reads that one outcome. The hook now returns a status, `loading` / `ready` / `unavailable`, instead of a boolean. The hook is module-private: it is not exported from the package entry.
- `JsonSourceEditor` and `SourcePageEditor` mount the Monaco `Editor` component only when the status is `ready`. While `loading` they render the same `Skeleton` their `Suspense` fallback already rendered. These two callers are edited because the doubled "Monaco initialization" line comes from them: it is the `Editor` component that each of them mounts, calling `loader.init()` itself and logging the rejection.
- On failure the hook adds one `unhandledrejection` listener. It cancels only a rejection whose `reason` is the loader's own failure object (compared by identity), and it logs the one warning.
- Patch changeset for `@object-ui/app-shell`.

## Mechanism, measured against the PM hypotheses

How it was measured: a temporary harness page in `apps/console` (never committed, deleted after) rendering the Studio source-page shape, which is `SourcePageEditor` in `mode="preview"` plus `SourcePageEditor` in `mode="editor"` as `StudioDesignSurface` mounts them, and a `JsonSourceEditor`. Driven in Chromium (`/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`) through Playwright, with every request to `cdn.jsdelivr.net` aborted (`internetdisconnected`). A delay of 800 ms before the abort models a failure that arrives after the editor has mounted, which is what the QA pass hit through its proxy. Counted: Playwright `pageerror` events, and console lines that mention Monaco.

| Shape | Uncaught `Event`, base `455c646` | "Monaco initialization" lines, base | Uncaught, this branch | Monaco console lines, this branch |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Studio shape, StrictMode, failure after mount | 6 | 2 | 0 | 1 warning naming the URL |
| Studio shape, no StrictMode, failure after mount | 3 | 1 | 0 | 1 warning |
| `JsonSourceEditor`, StrictMode, failure after mount | 4 | 2 | 0 | 1 warning |
| Studio shape, StrictMode, immediate failure | 4 | 0 | 0 | 1 warning |
| Second editor opened 1.5 s after the failure, StrictMode | 6 | 2 | 0 | 1 warning |

- **H1: confirmed in effect, corrected in where.** Every `loader.init()` call made while the loader fails leaves exactly one uncaught rejection, even though both callers already handle the promise `init()` returns (the hook with `.catch`, the `Editor` component with its own `.catch`). The unhandled promise is inside `@monaco-editor/loader` 1.7.0: `makeCancelable` subscribes to the page-wide promise with a bare `promise.then(onFulfilled)` and no rejection handler. The six are three callers (the preview hook, the editor hook, the `Editor` component) times StrictMode's double effects. 1.7.0 is the newest published version (`npm view @monaco-editor/loader dist-tags`, read 2026-10-08), so no version moves this.
- **H2: the doubling is StrictMode, not one line per editor.** The Studio shape has one `Editor`; without StrictMode it logs once. Chosen: one module-level probe and one module-level report. Per-mount handling cannot reach the library's internal promise, and one `init()` call is the floor: one rejection per page that no caller can reach. The listener is the only place left to catch it.
- **H3: the fallback is unchanged.** `useMonacoFallback.fastfail.test.tsx` is not edited and passes. The textarea appears at the same moment (when the loader rejects) and looks the same. Two other paths change, and both are named in the changeset: while Monaco is still loading on a working install, the editor area shows the `Skeleton` instead of Monaco's own "Loading..." text; and an editor opened after the failure is already known shows the textarea on its first render instead of one microtask later.

Success path, same harness, with the CDN served from the installed `monaco-editor@0.55.1` build through `route.fulfill`: the editor painted (a `.monaco-editor` node per editor), no fallback textarea, 0 page errors and 0 Monaco console lines, in the Studio shape, the `JsonSourceEditor` shape and the reopen shape.

## Tests (HEAD `93daa8c`)

- New pin `useMonacoFallback.loaderRejection-11800.test.tsx`. It mocks nothing about Monaco: it drives the real `@monaco-editor/loader` and the real `Editor` through the Studio shape under StrictMode. It holds the loader script back and fires its `error` event after the lazy editor module has loaded. It replays every Node unhandled rejection as a cancelable window `unhandledrejection` event, the way a browser reports them, and counts the ones nobody cancelled. It asserts: nothing uncaught, no `Editor` init line, one report containing the script's own `src`, no second report or script on a reopen, and an unrelated rejection still escapes.
- `bash os-verify-lock.sh -c 'pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2' FILES`, with FILES = the new pin plus every app-shell test that references the hook, its callers or mocks `@monaco-editor/react` (found with `git grep`): `useMonacoFallback.fastfail`, `JsonSourceEditor.fallback`, `JsonSourceEditor.monaco-export`, `previews/dataPreviews.i18n-10862-s3`, `ResourceEditPage.pageRequiresStamp-11357`, `StudioDesignSurface.interfacesReadOnly-11136`. Result: `Test Files  7 passed (7)`, `Tests  74 passed (74)`.
- `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...' --concurrency=2`: `Tasks: 28 successful, 28 total`. Then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` exit 0, which runs both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists the new pin (1 hit; the fast-fail test is the control, 1 hit).
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the four touched source and test files: exit 0, 0 errors. The 5 `no-explicit-any` warnings in `JsonSourceEditor.tsx` were already there before this change.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` exit 0, `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` exit 0, `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (`VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`), `pnpm check:control-bytes` OK, `pnpm check:test-path-roots` OK, `pnpm check:vi-mock-specifiers` OK, `pnpm check:vi-mock-override-shape` OK, `pnpm check:vi-mock-inherit` OK.

## Ablation, run once (not kept)

After the fix was committed, the three source files were put back to `455c646` with `git checkout BASE -- PATHS`, keeping the new pin. The base hook's own marker read 0 on disk for `probeMonacoLoader`, and the blob hashes equalled the base blobs. The new pin then failed, `Tests 1 failed (1)`, with its soft readings: `uncaught rejections after the loader failed: expected [ Array(6) ] to have a length of +0 but got 6`, `Editor's own init error lines: ... got 2`, `console lines reporting the Monaco failure: expected [] to have a length of 1 but got +0`, and after the reopen `got 7` uncaught. The files were restored with `git checkout HEAD -- PATHS` from a trap. Restore was proven by HEAD-blob hash equality for each of the three paths and an empty `git diff HEAD`. The vitest readings (6 and 2) match the QA pass's own numbers.

## Local verification scope (declared narrowing)

The whole `@object-ui/app-shell` suite is more than a thousand files on a shared 4-core container, so it was not run locally; CI's `pnpm test` runs it. The narrowing is to the test files that `git grep` finds referencing `useMonacoFallback`, `JsonSourceEditor` or `SourcePageEditor`, or mocking `@monaco-editor/react`. That search's blind spot: a test that renders a source editor through a parent component without naming any of them.

## Acceptance notes

- **Out of scope, handed to the seat as a class (a) finding (not fixed here):** Studio's `CodeWidget` (form rows of `type: 'code'`, rendered through `@object-ui/plugin-editor`'s `CodeEditorRenderer`) has no textarea fallback. With the CDN blocked it showed "javascript Loading..." after 10 s, with no editable control, plus 2 uncaught `Event` errors and 2 "Monaco initialization" lines under StrictMode. Its producers include `@objectstack/spec`'s `hookForm` `body.source` row and `objectForm`'s per-field `visibleWhen` / `requiredWhen` / `readonlyWhen` rows.
- `SourcePageEditor` in `mode="preview"` runs the hook, so the canvas preview alone triggers the CDN loader fetch. It adds nothing uncaught after this change, and in Studio the inspector editor mounts beside it anyway. Noted, not filed.
- The leak itself lives upstream in `@monaco-editor/loader`'s `makeCancelable`. No issue was filed upstream from here.
